stories.title: Weis Family Files Counterclaim in Suit Over $4 M. Pierre Soulages Painting
stories.sum: In its filing, the Weis estate said it “rejects the unfounded and moving-target theories alleged by the Zeckendorf,” calling them “flatly false.”

stories.title: New Anthropic, OpenAI models make same promise: A little more for a lot less money
stories.sum: The frontier AI model race has entered its comparison shopping phase.

stories.title: Sylvie in Paris? Netflix star to lead weekend rehang at this year's Art Basel Paris
stories.sum: Philippine Leroy-Beaulieu, best known to Anglophone audiences from the hit series Emily in Paris, will ‘art-direct’ the French fair's Oh La La! rehang programme

stories.title: Artist’s floating synagogue installation in Venice destroyed by harsh winds
stories.sum: Anna Kamyshan says she intends to “accept what I could not control” after the work, intended to symbolise both uncertainty and hope, was torn apart by a squall

stories.title: Hilla Rebay Helped Shape the Guggenheim. Now Her Own Art Is Getting Its Due
stories.sum: The German artist's bold, non-objective art is coming into view at Independent 20th Century, courtesy of Weinstein Gallery. The post Hilla Rebay Helped Shape the Guggenheim.

stories.title: Valve has ported Half-Life: Alyx to ARM, and it’s free with Steam Frame
stories.sum: Today, Valve is launching its first headset since 2019 - the new Steam Frame - while dodging our questions about whether it'll ever make another VR game to go with it.
